sentence: This project brings together researchers to fill the knowledge gap in carbon materials and devices.
This project builds open-source, hands-on materials that cover quantum computing and how it applies to machine learning.
This project builds software that adds a data reduction technique to neural networks so scientific programs can handle massive datasets.
This project looks at how to make cloud computing more secure and private against cyberattacks.
This project studies how drying affects carbon storage and cycling in tropical forests, using an experiment that reduces rainfall.
This project tests how well artificial intelligence methods that use physical laws predict coastal water movement and water quality.
This project develops a theory of how electrons move through superconducting materials and how magnetic field and material defects affect them.
This project tries to use wireless signals to do computation, so that machines that interact with each other can learn and decide faster.
This project builds a way to make rare earth permanent magnets by three-dimensional printing hydrogels and then decomposing and heating them.
This project builds a system that uses computer vision to detect wildlife and sound waves to keep the animals away from crops.
This project measures how much soil carbon has been lost because of human activities and looks for ways to reverse that loss.
This project studies how parental exposure to predation risk influences offspring and communities on rocky shores.
This project studies how genes and the environment work together to shape root growth in maize.
This project studies how droplets that form inside cells change the chemical reactions that happen there.
This project builds an injectable transponder that is powered by X-ray beams and reports tumor location and radiation dose during radiotherapy.
